# Live agent logs

One file per running agent: `<TASK_ID>-<role>-a<attempt>.md`, with a timestamped line after every step
(`- 05:31:07Z ran tests/jobs (10 passed) | next: commit`). Rules: master plan §3.2a and the §6 preamble.
Started 2026-09-27 at Stephen's request, so earlier agents (Phase 1 up to P1-T9's gauntlet) have no file here;
their start/finish entries are in `../BUILD_STATE.md`.
